# Old Forrest Consulting

> A two-person Utah firm doing Managed Intelligence for operations-heavy businesses:
> one partner in place of a fractional CTO, an MSP, a BI consultancy, and an integration
> vendor. We integrate the systems a company already runs, embed with its operators,
> maintain what we build, and build what's missing. Engagements are fixed-fee or a fixed
> monthly retainer, never an hourly meter.

## What we do

Four things, in plain terms:

- **Integrate** — make the systems a business already paid for talk to each other (CRM, accounting, field tools, time tracking, fleet).
- **Embed** — work alongside ownership and operators rather than delivering over a wall.
- **Maintain** — stay responsible for what we built, so there's one number to call.
- **Build** — write the software that doesn't exist yet, when buying it isn't an option.

The through-line is vendor consolidation: replacing a fleet of single-purpose vendors
with one accountable partner.

## Who we're a fit for

Operators whose records get challenged from outside — by a regulator, an
auditor, a lender, a counterparty, or a court — and who have nobody in-house
whose actual job is keeping those systems honest.

The test is three questions: does anyone outside your company ask you to prove
where a number came from; how long does that take and does it depend on one
person; and is there anybody in-house who owns it.

We have done this in title and land records, aerial survey, death care,
construction, law, clinical practice, minerals, and aviation. Those are
examples of one pattern, not separate practice areas — in each, the output has
to survive being questioned.

We are a poor fit for staff augmentation by the hour, or a single one-off
script with no ongoing relationship.

## How we price

Two ways to work with us, both priced before work starts:

- **Assessment** — $9,500 fixed, three weeks. Inventory, findings, a costed plan you keep.
- **Build** — fixed fee, milestone-billed. Additions arrive as written change orders.
- **Managed** — from $2,500/mo to run a named stack, with one scoped item included each month (sized by tier). Anything outside the named list is $2,500/day, one-day minimum. Unused months don't roll over.

We do not bill by the hour.

## What makes us different

- **Fixed price, stated before the work starts.** Assessments, builds, and monthly coverage all carry a number you see up front.
- **Your systems stay.** We don't require a platform migration to be useful. QuickBooks stays QuickBooks.
- **Determinism where it matters.** On engineering and survey work we enforce, in code, that outputs trace to real measured data rather than generative model output — with tests that fail the build if a model enters the path.
- **Client owns the code.** On build engagements, ownership transfers rather than being rented back.
